Cloak 0.2.1

Cloak in the Dock, in a smaller window

Cloak now appears in the Dock as well as the menu bar. Click the Dock icon to reopen the vault window or restore it when minimized.

The vault is now a smaller, fixed 560 × 420 window. The full sidebar, search, icon/list views, file switches, and secure notes remain available. Settings is smaller too, with scrolling options. The windows cannot be resized.

Closing the vault window still locks it and keeps Cloak available in the Dock and menu bar. Quit Cloak exits the app; encrypted files remain encrypted.

Cloak 0.2.0

Automatic app updates

Cloak now checks for new versions with Sparkle and verifies signed update downloads before installing them. Automatic checks and downloads are enabled by default; change them in Settings at any time.

Use Check for Updates… in the app menu, menu bar options, or Settings to check immediately. Updates wait for active vault transfers to finish and lock the vault before restarting the app.

Install this disk image once to upgrade an older build without Sparkle. Future releases can then arrive through the updater. This remains a development build without Apple notarization.
